messages:
maria: sharing the updated trace viewer mock — focused on drilldown header + stack snippet. quick ask: should export be a primary CTA or tucked into the kebab menu? also open to copy tweaks for the stack snippet label. https://figma.com/s/trace-mock

*tariq:* i lean toward kebab menu for export. primary CTA should be an action users do frequently (e.g., pin/annotate), export is rarer and can confuse screen-reader flow.
*sam:* agree with @tariq. if export stays visible we need clear aria-labels and keyboard order. current tab order goes: correlation pill -> export -> more. i'd swap export to after more so it's reach-only.
*katie:* copy note: "Stack snippet" feels vague for non-dev PMs. maybe "Relevant stack frames" or "Top stack frames (filtered)". also add microcopy under correlation id: "click to copy full id" so people don't wonder why only part shows.
*maria:* good call. i like "Relevant stack frames". for export placement i'm torn because support people ask for one-click export during incident. could we surface export as a lightweight icon (not primary button) next to the kebab, with tooltip and aria-label? that keeps visual weight lower but still quick.
*tariq:* +1 for an icon-only affordance. for screen readers we should have `aria-label="Export trace (.zip)"` and ensure the icon has a visible focus ring. also keyboard users should be able to trigger with Enter/Space.
*sam:* small a11y nit: when the drilldown opens, focus should move to the pane heading, not stay on the trace list. otherwise NVDA/VoiceOver users get lost. add `role="dialog" aria-modal="false"` and set `aria-labelledby` to the header id.
*katie:* copy variant for the export tooltip ideas: "Export trace (.zip)" vs "Download trace & attachments" — second is clearer for incidents. prefer second.
*maria:* decision proposal:
- show small download icon right of kebab (no extra weight)
- kebab keeps export in menu too (redundant path)
- label: "Download trace & attachments"
- stack label: "Relevant stack frames"
- add small helper under correlation id: "Click to copy full correlation ID"
- move focus to drilldown heading on open
*tariq:* looks good. add acceptance criteria: keyboard focus order tested; screen reader reads heading + copy; icon has `aria-label` and visible focus indicator.
*design-bot:* accessibility checklist: keyboard focus order, aria-labels present, tooltip accessible, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for helper text. Missing: visible focus ring on icon.
*maria:* i'll update the figma and push a short prototype for keyboard nav. can someone volunteer to run a quick screen-reader pass after i push?
*katie:* i'll run VoiceOver on mac and leave notes.
*sam:* i'll run NVDA on win10 and report back.
*maria:* thanks team :heart: small follow-ups: (1) @tariq can you draft the exact aria attributes? (2) i'll add microcopy variants in figma.
*tariq:* on it — draft will include `button` role for icon, `aria-label="Download trace and attachments"`, `tabindex="0"`, and `aria-describedby` pointing to helper text for screen readers.
*maria:* perfect, leaving this open until prototype. thumbs if you're ok with the plan.
*katie:* :thumbsup:
*sam:* :thumbsup:
*tariq:* :thumbsup:
*design-bot:* thread archived in 48h if no activity.
